title: AIRWAY — Reproducible Paired RNA-seq Analysis and Offline Scientific Task Evaluation
description:
Executable reanalysis of paired dexamethasone-treated human airway smooth muscle RNA-seq samples, with PyDESeq2 and a separate R/DESeq2 reference, reproducibility evidence, and offline scientific task evaluation. The research extension includes donor sensitivity analyses, pathway methods, and simulation experiments.

The MIT license covers original code and documentation. Exported data and annotation retain their upstream terms and attribution, documented in data/LICENSE-NOTES.md and data/manifest.json. Sources include the Bioconductor airway package and Himes et al. (2014), DOI 10.1371/journal.pone.0099625, GEO GSE52778.
